主要内容: On February 23, 2012, SAP AG, a German-based multinational corporation, announced that its Executive Board would recommend to the Supervisory Board to propose at the Annual General Meeting of Shareholders to increase the dividend by 83% from €0.60 to €1.10 per share for the fiscal year 2011. This announcement was made through a press release, which is included as Exhibit 99.1 in the Form 6-K filing. The document also includes forward-looking statements regarding SAP's future financial results, which are subject to various risks and uncertainties. The filing was submitted to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on February 24, 2012.
